paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.17% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+0.86%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.60%). Brent crude changed -1.47% to 100.75. Gold changed -0.13% to 4,156.7002. Bitcoin changed -1.50% to 85,182.1719. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.328%, a relative move of +0.97%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-5.60%) and Santander (+3.78%) moved the most.
